term: Medicinal and Adult-Use Cannabis Regulation and Safety Act (MAUCRSA)
definition: The Medicinal and Adult-Use Cannabis Regulation and Safety Act (MAUCRSA) is the California state law that created the regulatory scheme for legal cannabis use in California. The law followed the passage of Proposition 64, which legalized adult-use, recreational cannabis use in the state. The law supplanted and consolidated the existing Medical Cannabis Regulation and Safety Act, which had previously provided a regulatory framework for medical cannabis use in the state. See: California Department of Cannabis Control and the Sacramento County Public Law Library for additional information.
